dimensions.name: Day Type
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END

dimensions.name: Gender
dimensions.expr: CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male' ELSE 'Unknown' END

dimensions.name: Age Band
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN '00-17' WHEN age < 30 THEN '18-29' WHEN age < 45 THEN '30-44' WHEN age < 60 THEN '45-59' WHEN age < 75 THEN '60-74' ELSE '75+' END

measures.name: Senior Share
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FILTER (WHERE age >= 65) / COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id)

measures.name: Female Share
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'F') / COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id)
